product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai provides low-power MLSoC hardware and development software for teams building and deploying physical-AI applications at the edge.

pricing_page.notes: Edgematic publishes Free, Premium and Business plans; paid tiers direct visitors to contact the company.

named_customers.notes: The reviewed case studies anonymize their customers as an industrial leader and a global retailer. Partnership announcements were not counted as customer evidence.

eng_blog.notes: Includes a Modalix engineering deep dive by VP Hardware Engineering Srivi Dhruvanarayan and an LLiMa compiler-framework article by Associate VP, MLA Software Ashok Sudarsanam.

public_docs.notes: The public Developer Center contains hardware and software documentation, examples and development guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-positions board lists Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification (AI2517). The individual job URL displayed general careers content when opened.

model_provider.notes: The conversational-AI page explicitly describes Gemma language reasoning running on-device on Modalix.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed quality and privacy policies name none of the five requested standards; this does not establish that the company lacks them.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 28, 2026; $150 million is the round amount, not the $500 million cumulative funding total.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 28, 2026 Series C falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The reviewed open-positions board lists no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive titles.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 7, 2026 Palette Neat v0.5.0 announcement introduces expanded live-video, spatial-awareness, image-understanding and voice capabilities, including a new audio API.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Young-Hun Kluge's profile lists a March 2026 start as Senior Vice President, Global Business Development Automotive at SiMa.ai.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Sales & Revenue Operations posting explicitly assigns Salesforce CRM management, data hygiene, reporting and forecasting responsibilities.
